explanation: dualMassE_le bounds the dual mass by the weights of nonzero integer v orthogonal to ker M, M = [I (x) B | W]. Splitting v into its l blocks of m coordinates and its W part (blockEquiv), each block is orthogonal to ker B and the W part to ker W (embed a kernel vector of B in one block, or of W in the W part; stacked_mulVec shows it is in ker M). The weight factorizes over the blocks (wt is a product of one-dimensional weights), so the sum over the larger set is (S_B + 1)^l (S_W + 1) by tsum_prod and a generic tsum_pi_prod.
